content: ईम् {%ind.%} [ई-बा˚ मुच्] <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 A particle of affirmation or restriction; usually after short words at the beginning of a sentence, after यत्, relative pronouns prepositions and particles like उत, अथ <ab>&c.</ab>; प्र यदीमुवाचेति <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 5. 16</ls>. .²2 Now. .²3 This, here (एनम्).
